text: Meera's daughter starts Year 1 on Monday. She's more nervous than the little one is, apparently.
Remind me to ask Connor how his daughter's first day at nursery went. It was this morning at 9.
Laura and Ben are getting a puppy next Saturday, a cocker spaniel. They've already named him Biscuit.
Spoke to Haruto on the phone. His cat Miso has been off her food for three days and he's taking her to the vet tomorrow at 10am. He sounded really worried.
Need to post the graduation card to Keisha before Friday. Her ceremony is next Wednesday at 2pm.
Picking up the dry cleaning tomorrow morning, then the big shop on Saturday.

Eli passed his driving test! Third attempt, after failing the last one on a roundabout. He rang me straight from the test centre this morning and could barely get the words out. His girlfriend has already put him on the insurance for her car, so he's driving them to the coast next weekend. Send him a proper congratulations message tonight, and maybe some L-plate-free keyrings as a joke.
Yasmin's son has his GCSE results on Thursday. She said he's convinced he's failed maths, but his teacher thinks he'll be fine.
Naledi wants to meet for lunch next Tuesday at half 12. I said yes, the place near her office.
Nadia's dog Pepper turns ten this weekend. She's doing a little party for her in the garden, which is very Nadia.
Luis mentioned his mum is moving in with them in a fortnight. He seems a bit overwhelmed by it all.
Call Zeynep on Sunday afternoon. We keep missing each other.
Khadija graduated from her nursing degree yesterday. Her whole family came over from Leeds for it.
Nina said the puppy classes are on Thursday evenings at 7. She thinks I should bring Bramble.
Milan's leaving do has been called off because half the team are off sick. They might rearrange for next month.
Don't forget to send Rafael the photos from the christening. He asked twice now.
Dawit's little boy lost his first tooth this morning and is extremely proud of himself.
Sam and his wife are flying to Lisbon on the 14th at 6am. Their neighbour is feeding the cats.
Jakub is struggling with his dissertation. Deadline is Friday at 5pm and he's barely sleeping. I should check in with him on Wednesday.
Elif's twins start secondary school next week. She's already labelled every single item of uniform.
Aditi loves orchids. She has about fifteen on her kitchen windowsill.

Coffee with Jorge went well. He's training for the Manchester half marathon in April and has finally sorted his knee out after months of physio. He runs with a club on Tuesday and Thursday evenings now and does a long run on Sunday mornings. He's thinking about a full marathon next year if the half goes well. He also mentioned he's started baking sourdough, which I did not see coming.
Dana's rabbit, Clover, had an operation on Monday. She's recovering, but Dana is still keeping her indoors. Must text her tomorrow evening to see how Clover is doing.
Uma is vegan now, has been since the summer. Worth remembering for the dinner.

Joy's niece is graduating from Edinburgh next Friday morning. Joy is driving up on Thursday night with her sister and coming back Sunday. Her niece did a degree in marine biology and has already been offered a research post in Aberdeen starting in January. Joy is so proud she showed me the photos from the offer email.
Santiago is coming to stay this weekend. He arrives Friday at about 8pm. I need to make up the spare room and buy some decent coffee before then.
Oisín said his granddad is in hospital again with his chest. Oisín is going over to see him on Saturday morning.
Remind me to ring Yusuf on Thursday at lunchtime to see how his interview went. It's on Wednesday at 11.

Alana's daughter got into the grammar school! Alana cried telling me about it on the phone this evening. They found out this morning and apparently her daughter screamed so loudly the neighbours came round to check everything was alright. She starts in September and they're already panicking about the bus route. Send flowers or something this week, and maybe a little card for her daughter too.
Luca's new kitten is called Pasta. He sent me about forty photos this afternoon.

Had a long catch-up with Keisha. Her brother Eli is moving to Bristol next month for a new job at the university, and their mum is not handling it well at all. Keisha is going down with him on the 3rd to help with the move. She also mentioned she fancies doing a pottery course in the new year, maybe on Tuesday evenings.

Haruto's son has his piano exam on Saturday at half 10. Grade 3. He's been practising every night after dinner and Haruto says the whole street now knows the pieces by heart. The poor kid is really nervous about the sight-reading part. Haruto and his wife are both taking him, then going for pancakes afterwards whatever happens.
Must book the car in for its MOT before the end of the month.
Meera said Connor's dad isn't well. Probably best not to mention the barbecue to him for now.

Laura told me her parents' fortieth anniversary is on the 22nd. She and her sister are throwing them a surprise dinner on the Saturday after, at 7pm. I'm doing the cake. Need to ask Laura how many people are coming by next Monday.

Yasmin's cat, Mr Whiskers, went missing on Tuesday night. Still no sign of him. She's put posters up all over the estate and posted in every local Facebook group. Her kids are heartbroken and keep leaving his food bowl out by the back door. She's checking the vets and the shelter again tomorrow morning. I should ring her on Saturday and offer to help with a proper search of the allotments.
Ben's starting his new job at the council on Monday morning. He's really nervous about the commute.

Nadia and Luis are coming for dinner on Friday at 7.30. Nadia is allergic to nuts, so no pesto, and Luis doesn't eat mushrooms. They're bringing their little one, who goes to bed around 8, so they might leave early. Luis said they've got news to share, which I suspect is the new house. I need to buy a high chair cover and some wine on Thursday.
Zeynep's daughter had her first swimming lesson today and refused to get out of the pool at the end.
Text Khadija good luck before her OSCE exam on Monday morning. She is absolutely terrified of it.
Nina's birthday is on the 9th. She keeps saying she needs a new yoga mat because hers is falling apart.
Got back from Milan and Dana's housewarming. Lovely flat. Their dog Toffee is enormous now.
Dr Patel said the results should be back by next Thursday. I'll ring the surgery on Friday morning if I haven't heard.
Rafael's mum is turning seventy next Sunday. He's taking her to the coast for lunch. He said she's been hinting about a new reading lamp.
Ask Dawit how his daughter's school play went. It was last night and she had a speaking part.
Sam Hughes from the running club has a new puppy, a whippet called Dart. He's bringing her to the park on Sunday morning.
The parents' evening on Thursday is cancelled because of the strike, so Jakub and I are going to the cinema instead.

Elif rang. Her dad had a fall at the weekend and is in a cast for six weeks. She's going over every evening after work to help him. I should send her a meal voucher or drop something round on Wednesday.
Aditi Kim is my new manager from Monday. She used to work at the BBC.
Jorge's son is doing his A-levels this summer and wants to study veterinary medicine. Jorge is quietly very proud.
Uma and her husband are expecting their second in March! She told me at the school gates this morning. Don't forget to get something small for their eldest so she doesn't feel left out.
Joy says her parrot, Captain, has learned to imitate the microwave. It goes off at 6am every day.
Need to organise the playdate with Santiago's kids. Maybe Saturday afternoon, or next Sunday if the weather's bad.
Oisín (Osh to everyone at work) has his citizenship ceremony on Tuesday at 11am. Must remember to bring a card in on Monday.
Yusuf mentioned his wife has just started a part-time PhD in history. She's doing it around the kids.

Long call with Alana tonight. Her dog Juno was diagnosed with diabetes last week, so it's insulin injections twice a day now, morning and evening. Alana's finding it really hard to fit around work and the kids' swimming. Her husband is away until Thursday as well. I offered to walk Juno on Wednesday afternoon. Should check in with her again on Friday.
Luca and his partner are getting married in Sicily next June. Save the dates are coming out in a fortnight.
Clean the gutters this weekend. Also return the drill to next door.
Connor's son Santiago, Santi for short, graduates from primary school on Friday at 2. Connor's taking the afternoon off and his mum is coming too. Remind me to send Santi a message that evening.
Meera Barros is a big fan of Studio Ghibli. Her favourite is Spirited Away.
